title: Miku
lyrics:
[00:16.89]Miku, Miku, you can call me Miku
[00:20.63]Blue hair, blue tie, hiding in your Wi-Fi
[00:24.44]Open secrets, anyone can find me
[00:28.17]Hear your music running through my mind
[00:31.23]I'm thinking Miku, Miku, oo-ee-oo
[00:34.96]I'm thinking Miku, Miku, oo-ee-oo
[00:38.71]I'm thinking Miku, Miku, oo-ee-oo
[00:42.46]I'm thinking Miku, Miku, oo-ee-oo
[00:46.96]I'm on top of the world because of you
[00:50.68]All I wanted to do is follow you
[00:54.44]I'll keep singing along to all of you
[00:58.17]I'll keep singing along
[01:01.20]I'm thinking Miku, Miku, oo-ee-oo
[01:04.96]I'm thinking Miku, Miku, oo-ee-oo
[01:08.70]I'm thinking Miku, Miku, oo-ee-oo
[01:12.47]I'm thinking Miku, Miku, oo-ee-oo
[01:16.90]Miku, Miku, what's it like to be you?
[01:20.60]20/20, looking in the rear view
[01:24.39]Play me, break me, make me feel like Superman
[01:28.64]You can do anything you want
[01:46.96]I'm on top of the world because of you
[01:50.68]All I wanted to do is follow you
[01:54.41]I'll keep singing along to all of you
[01:58.17]I'll keep singing along
[02:01.94]I'm on top of the world because of you
[02:05.67]I do nothing that they could never do
[02:09.42]I'll keep playing along with all of you
[02:13.18]I'll keep playing along
[02:16.21]I'm thinking Miku, Miku, oo-ee-oo
[02:19.96]I'm thinking Miku, Miku, oo-ee-oo
[02:23.72]I'm thinking Miku, Miku, oo-ee-oo
[02:27.46]I'm thinking Miku, Miku, oo-ee-oo
[02:46.87]Where we were walking together?
[02:48.34]I will see you in the end
[02:50.44]I'll take you where you've never been
[02:52.32]And bring you back again
[02:54.37]Listen to me with your eyes
[02:56.08]I'm watching you from in the sky
[02:57.94]If you forget, I'll fade away
[02:59.83]I'm asking you to let me stay
[03:01.66]So bathe me in your magic light
[03:03.56]And keep it on in darkest night
[03:05.44]I need you here to keep me strong
[03:07.30]To live my life and sing along
[03:09.18]I'm lying with you wide awake
[03:11.02]Like your expensive poison snake
[03:12.90]You found me here inside a dream
[03:14.76]Walk through the fire straight to me
